newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Friday, dealers said, as prices consolidate losses made during the previous session.

Technically driven selling by the trade and the funds pressed most-active July down 0.17 cent to 11.07 cents per lb on the close. May ended 0.07 weaker at 11.46, while the back months settled 0.03 higher to 0.02 lower.
Volume was estimated to have reached 41,274 lots.
The last trading day for the May contract is April 30.

LIFFE white sugar futures were barely changed in rangebound dealings at midday on Friday. At 0900 EST/1400 GMT, August was up 30 cents at $313.10, up $3.10, while the back months stood unchanged to 60 cents weaker.
((-- S Rostler New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
